newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall on Bulgaria 1-,4-week discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on Bulgaria 1-,4-week discount T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell at Tuesday's auctions of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bills, central bank figures showed.
The average yields to maturity of the two issues were 1.69 percent and 10.69 percent, respectively, down from 1.95 and 12.75 percent at Monday's auctions.
Bids were received for a total of 81.688 billion levs of T-bills for today's auctions but the ministry approved bids for 53.035 billion levs worth of paper.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 25,000 million levs 40,000 million levs
Bids received 13,035 million levs 68,652.8 million levs
Bids approved 13,035 million levs 40,000 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 1.69 pct 10.69 pct
